title: I don’t see why you should expect payment for it since you don’t believe it yourself
html_source:
William Kirpatrick McGee (pen name John Eglinton) edited a literary journal called Dana. This journal published one of Joyce’s poems.
https://jamesjoyce.ie/on-this-day-4-december/

The Ulysses character Eglinton assumes Stephen is pitching him the Shakespeare theory as an idea for a piece in Dana.
